result.citation: Jersey City Mun. Code ch. 260 (Ord. No. C-14A)
result.citation_basis: ch. 260: O081 (also D036); Ord. No. C-14A: O081 chapter history footnote
result.official_quote: Dwellings with four or less housing spaces; provided, however, that this exemption shall be suspended for non-owner occupied dwellings with four or less housing spaces until the end of the state of emergency or six months from adoption of these amendments whichever comes first.
result.note: Added the adopting ordinance (Ord. No. C-14A, per the code's chapter history) to the chapter cite, which stays chapter-wide because the card covers the whole Rent Control chapter and its 1-4 unit exemption sits in the § 260-1 definitions section.
